name: Hair by Ciera
description: Hair by Ciera is a color-loving stylist specialising in rich reds, burgundies, and dimensional color, plus bouncy curls, cuts, and healthy-hair treatments that make your color shine.

hero.title: Color that turns heads.
hero.subtitle: Rich reds, deep burgundies, dimensional highlights, and soft bouncy curls by Ciera — book your color appointment today.

stylists.name: Ciera
stylists.title: Owner & Color Specialist
stylists.bio: Ciera lives for color — especially rich reds, burgundies, and dimensional tones that catch the light. She pairs bold color with healthy-hair care and soft, bouncy styling so every client leaves feeling confident and beautiful.

reviews.name: Vanessa L.
reviews.text: Ciera gave me the burgundy of my dreams! It's so rich and shiny, and it's held up beautifully.

reviews.name: Priscilla G.
reviews.text: My highlights have so much dimension now. She really knows color and explains everything.

reviews.name: Dominique R.
reviews.text: Best blowout and curls ever. I felt like a whole new woman walking out.

reviews.name: Erica S.
reviews.text: So sweet, professional, and talented. My hair feels healthier than before my color!
